title: SMOK Novo Eco Pod Vape Kit
description: Please Note: USB Cable Sold Separately Compact and lightweight yet able to produce incredible flavour with a discreet yet satisfying vapour output, the Novo Eco is a worthy addition to Smok’s legendary Novo pod kit series. The Eco offers a maximum power output of 30W, making it a versatile choice for both Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) and Restricted Direct-to-Lung (RDL) vaping styles. Its long-lasting 1000mAh removable battery not only provides reliable, all-day performance but also supports easy recycling, offering an eco-friendlier solution for modern vapers who value a more sustainable approach to vaping. It wouldn’t be a Novo device without convenience and usability at the forefront, and to that end the Novo Eco kit features an intuitive sliding airflow control, allowing you to fine-tune your inhale to suit your preferences. With dual power modes—Hard and Soft—you can further customise your vaping experience to enjoy either a more intense or smoother draw. The Novo Eco kit is compatible with a wide range of Smok Novo pods, including Novo SLR pods (0.8ohm included) and Novo, Novo 2, and Novo 2X pods (sold separately), ensuring versatility with plenty of resistances to experiment with different vape liquids . The Novo Eco pods feature a no-fuss spring-loaded fixed-coil design and a top-fill system for quick and mess-free refills. Best used with 50:50 VG:PG e-liquids or nicotine salts, this kit ensures smooth flavour delivery and satisfying yet discreet vapour production. A colour-coded RGB light indicator makes it easy to monitor remaining battery life, while USB-C charging keeps downtime to a minimum. With its adjustable power modes, airflow control, and sustainable design, the Smok Novo Eco Pod Vape Kit is an exceptional choice for vapers seeking simplicity, style, and customisation in a single, take-anywhere device. We recommend using 50/50 or Nic Salt E-Liquid with this kit Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
